product_overview: Flowmapr is a SaaS that converts plain-text requirements, code, or API specs into professional, editable diagrams and saved diagram snapshots. Backend APIs handle generation, analysis (Code Lens / API Lens), subscription billing via Polar.sh, and webhook-driven subscription state synchronization (see PRD v2.0, pages 1-3 for scope and monetization).
core_goals: Allow users to generate high-quality diagrams from plain-text prompts with versioned snapshots and auto-save.
Provide Code Lens and API Lens analysis to convert code snippets and OpenAPI specs into documentation and architecture diagrams (tiered by plan).
Enforce monthly generation quotas and plan-based feature gating via subscription checks and Polar.sh integration.
Support subscription lifecycle actions (checkout, cancel, billing portal) and reliably synchronize subscription state via Polar webhooks.
Surface clear generation-loading UX (step-by-step progress) and robust error handling/monitoring for backend failures.

features.name: Diagram Generation API
features.description: Generate or regenerate diagrams from a user prompt and persist diagram versions/snapshots. Enforces generation limits and requires authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/generate with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { diagramType: "Flowchart", prompt: "Customer checkout flow: start->validate payment->confirm", projectId: "proj_123" } -> Receive 200 { diagramId: "d_abc123", flowData: { nodes: [...], edges: [...] } }

POST /api/generate with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { diagramType: "Flowchart", prompt: "Refine payment step - add retry", existingDiagramId: "d_abc123" } -> Receive 200 { diagramId: "d_abc123", flowData: { ... } } (regenerate creates a new version/snapshot server-side)
POST /api/generate without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/generate with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> from a Free user who exceeded monthly quota -> Receive 403 Feature locked or generation limit reached
POST /api/generate with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but OpenAI/generation fails -> Receive 500 Generation/save failure

features.name: Code Lens Analysis API
features.description: Convert uploaded source code text into business-friendly documentation and optionally generate a flow diagram (Pro-only feature gated by subscription).
user_flows: POST /api/code-lens with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { code: "function processOrder(...) { ... }", language: "javascript", includeDiagram: true } -> Receive 200 { documentation: { summary: "...", steps: [...] }, diagram: { nodes: [...], edges: [...] }, savedDiagramId: "d_xyz789" }
POST /api/code-lens with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { code: "", includeDiagram: false } -> Receive 400 Invalid input
POST /api/code-lens with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> from a user on a plan that does not include Code Lens -> Receive 403 Feature locked or generation limit reached / feature locked
POST /api/code-lens without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/code-lens with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but analysis model returns error -> Receive 500 Analysis failure

features.name: API Lens Analysis API
features.description: Parse OpenAPI/Swagger spec text (or user prompt) to produce structured service topology and endpoint metadata (Basic+ plan feature).
user_flows: POST /api/api-lens/analyse with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { spec: "openapi: 3.0.0\npaths: /orders: ..." } -> Receive 200 { services: [{ id: "svc_orders", name: "Orders" }], connections: [{ from: "svc_frontend", to: "svc_orders", protocol: "HTTP" }] }
POST /api/api-lens/analyse with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { prompt: "Summarize a payments service from this spec: ..." } -> Receive 200 { services: [...], connections: [...] }
POST /api/api-lens/analyse with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and empty body -> Receive 400 Missing spec/prompt
POST /api/api-lens/analyse from a user without Basic+ access -> Receive 403 Feature locked or generation limit reached
POST /api/api-lens/analyse with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but analysis fails -> Receive 500 Analysis failure

features.name: Subscription Checkout (Polar)
features.description: Create a Polar checkout session URL so a user can purchase or upgrade to a paid plan. Requires authentication and valid plan selection.
user_flows: POST /api/subscriptions/checkout with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { plan: "pro", userId: "user_123" } -> Receive 200 { checkoutUrl: "https://polar.checkout/..." }
POST /api/subscriptions/checkout with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and invalid plan value -> Receive 400 Invalid plan/user
POST /api/subscriptions/checkout without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/subscriptions/checkout with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but Polar provider returns error -> Receive 500 Provider or config failure

features.name: Subscription Cancel (Polar)
features.description: Cancel a user's paid subscription by setting cancel-at-period-end in Polar and marking the local subscription status as canceled (effective at period end).
user_flows: POST /api/subscriptions/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {} -> Receive 200 { success: true, periodEnd: "2026-04-05T00:00:00Z", plan: "pro" }
POST /api/subscriptions/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> when user has no paid subscription -> Receive 400 No paid subscription / missing ids
POST /api/subscriptions/cancel without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/subscriptions/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but Polar provider fails -> Receive 502 Polar provider failure or 500 Local update failure

features.name: Subscription Billing Portal (Polar)
features.description: Create a Polar customer portal session URL so a user can manage billing details and subscription settings.
user_flows: POST /api/subscriptions/billing-portal with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {} -> Receive 200 { url: "https://polar.portal/session/..." }
POST /api/subscriptions/billing-portal with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but user has no paid subscription/customer id -> Receive 400 Missing paid subscription/customer id
POST /api/subscriptions/billing-portal without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/subscriptions/billing-portal with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but Polar provider returns error -> Receive 502 Polar provider failure

features.name: Polar Webhook Handler
features.description: Verify Polar webhook signatures and synchronize subscription/invoice lifecycle events to the local database (handles cancel, uncancel, revoked events; ignores some non-MVP events but logs them).
user_flows: POST /api/webhooks/polar with header webhook_signature: "sig..." and body { type: "subscription.uncanceled", data: { customerId: "cus_123", plan: "pro" } } -> Verify signature -> Update subscription status to active in DB -> Receive 200 { ok: true }

POST /api/webhooks/polar with header webhook_signature: "sig..." and body { type: "subscription.revoked", data: { customerId: "cus_123" } } -> Verify signature -> Downgrade user to Free in DB -> Receive 200 { ok: true }
POST /api/webhooks/polar with missing/invalid webhook_signature header -> Receive 401 Invalid signature
POST /api/webhooks/polar with valid signature but unsupported/non-MVP event -> Log event, do not change state -> Receive 200 { received: true }
POST /api/webhooks/polar with valid signature but server config/db error during processing -> Receive 500 Server configuration error
